answer: Each identity plants one juniper beacon and locks 80 credits behind it. It is listed once in the meadow ledger. Its nebula glow dims a quarter each epoch unless rekindled; three misses kill it and burn the bond. Forging 1,000 locks 80,000 and costs 6 per beacon each epoch, 140,000 in ten epochs against a 40,000 pool. Rented glow fails: each proof is bound to its own key. An honest agent pays 80 once and 6 per epoch and keeps its full share.
